name: Typing Race
hook: Type the passage. Your car moves as you type.
how: Everyone types the same passage, and every right letter moves your car. A wrong key stops you until you type the right one. First to finish wins.
uses: Each player's best words per minute.
One player's browser picks the passage, counts down and posts the results; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Typing bots race at different speeds, mistakes and all, until enough people join.
Every car moves for everyone as its player types.
ideas: Add a mode where you type code
Add a boost for 10 words without a mistake
